page.content:
Directed by Laurence Olivier, Hamlet premiered on October 22nd 1963 at the Old Vic Theatre in London. It ws the first production of England's National Theatre. It featured a score by John Addison.

Who is Hamlet?

Directed by Laurence Olivier, Hamlet premiered on October 22nd 1963 at the Old Vic Theatre in London. It ws the first production of England's National Theatre. It featured a score by John Addison.
